description: The agent loop's shared vectors (RFC-0011 build plan step 2): llm.run, run against a scripted llm.chat and scripted tool routes, so no tokens are spent. mercury-composable (Java) and mercury (Rust) ship this file byte-identical. A case names the configuration keys in force (the global defaults of the settings), the tool routes that are reachable (llm.chat is reachable unless llm_chat is false), the llm.run input, its turns and the expectation: the outcome envelope, or the error (status and exact message), and when the case lists events, the progress events the loop sends to its caller's return route (build plan step 3), compared in order: type, event, seq, time (ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds, from the harness's clock) and data; a case without events does not check them. The harness's clock starts at 0 when the run starts. A turn may first list the route calls a resume makes before its first model turn (before); otherwise it is one llm.chat exchange: the exact request the loop sends (maps compared by keys, numbers by value), the milliseconds the turn takes on the clock (elapsed_ms, default 0), and the reply body or the error the scripted llm.chat answers with; then the route calls the loop makes before its next turn, in any order, each matched by its route and body and answered with its reply body or its error. Every scripted turn and call must be used, and none other made. The schema cases compile a tool input schema at the place 'schema' and validate an input at the path 'input': the expected violations in order, the capped report when given, or the compile error.
